title: Pumpkin Chestnut Pasta
subtitle: linguine in a browned butter pumpkin cream sauce
description: Pumpkin, chestnuts and fresh chilli are ground into a paste with brown butter, then melted into a cream sauce and tossed through linguine. Butternut or any fresh pumpkin works.

steps.text: Melt the butter in a pan over high heat and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring, until brown. Remove from the heat.
Grind the pumpkin, chestnuts and chilli in a mincer or food processor and transfer to a bowl.
Add the brown butter, salt and smoked paprika and mix to a paste. Refrigerate for about 30 minutes until firm.
Heat the olive oil in a wide pot over medium heat, add the pumpkin paste and heat until melted, stirring occasionally. Add the cream and cook for about 5 minutes until reduced by half.
Cook the linguine according to the packet directions, then add it to the pot and stir. Add the parsley and season with salt and pepper.
Serve with parmesan and chopped chestnuts, if you like.
